ranked.text: The forecast-pipeline failure symptom is associated with demand-data validation-gate failures, specifically range and/or completeness checks.
Demand reporting from fewer than all four load zones starved the pipeline of complete demand inputs, contributing to validation-gate failures.
Ingestion received malformed vendor payloads or HTTP 503 responses from the primary weather vendor, and the resulting bad or missing data propagated to the forecast pipeline.
A recent GitOps commit or rollout touching forecast-pipeline or a directly connected service introduced a regression that caused the pipeline failures.
Forecast-service inference latency or model reloading delayed pipeline execution beyond its failure threshold.
